gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-tc: Flavors stands tall on a stubby, pencil-thick x-height, its diagonals as hefty as its stems, while Noto Sans TC stays open and approachable underneath. Whimsy with muscle.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-telugu: Sleek, techy, a bit like glowing tiles in a row. Noto Sans Telugu does the quiet reading work, its counters staying open to the outside, while Audiowide handles the swagger.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-thai: Menacing is Eater's whole mood, with wide gaps between letters and short ascenders that keep it low and sinister. And Noto Sans Thai, with its rounded, bead-like lowercase, would read smoothly over a full page.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-thai-looped: Noto Sans Thai Looped reads bold, thanks to its tall bodies. Over a long passage it would feel spacious, with open curve terminals letting each line breathe while Flavors, drawn like bent pipe, sits above it.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-tirhut: Noto Sans Tirhuta brings a contemporary, clean look, with terminals cut back to leave big gaps and a dominant x-height, against Almendra Display's ornate, literary heading. A long passage would flow easily.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-ugaritic: Eater looks dark and aggressive, yet its thin strokes never turn spindly beside the moderately weighty stems. But Noto Sans Ugaritic, with its tiny step from lowercase to capitals, would read as a friendly, compact block over many lines.
gen-flavors-gf-noto-sans-vai: Flavors looks like letters bent from a single length of wire, with diagonals just as hefty as the stems and a towering x-height. Its boldness is the pair's best quality.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-wancho: Noto Sans Wancho reads hulking and heavy, like thick chalk pressed hard onto a board. Almendra Display adds ornate, literary lettering above it, and its pronounced x-height lets the two sit comfortably together.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-vithkuqi: Audiowide draws everything with a pen that never changes pressure or angle. Noto Sans Vithkuqi, with open throats on a, c, e and s, would feel clean and modern across a long passage.
gen-eater-gf-noto-sans-warang-citi: Noto Sans Warang Citi gives words that read as solid blocks, with wide channels leading into each counter, against Eater's dark heading. Body text in the 16 to 18 pixel range feels about right.
